**iDevBench Browser Edition {VERSION}** (formerly Location Spoofer) — the edition that runs in your web browser, built on pymobiledevice3. Use it if you need iOS 17.0–17.3 support or the pymobiledevice3 command fallback; otherwise the native Windows app is recommended.{CHANNEL_NOTE}

### Install
1. Install [**Apple Devices**](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9np83lwlpz9k) from the Microsoft Store (free, made by Apple; iTunes also works).
2. Download **`iDevBenchBrowser.exe`** below (`LocationSpooferBrowser.exe` is the same file under its old name, for copies installed before the rename) and save it in a folder you own.
3. Run it. A console window opens (closing it quits the app) and the app opens in your web browser. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

Already installed? The app updates itself; press **Restart now** when it offers.
